attempts.summary: Created a self-signed root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (RSA 4096, 10-year validity, CN=OS Comparison Root CA) and installed it into the system trust store via update-ca-certificates. Verified trust with a freshly issued leaf certificate that openssl verified using only the default system CA bundle (no -CAfile). Then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and CA trust state, issued a native reboot whose acknowledgement returned before disconnect, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and re-verified the CA files and trust functionality post-reboot with a second independent leaf-cert verification.
